summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Ecopetrol S.A., a Colombian energy company, reporting the final agreement of a collective bargaining process with the Oil Workers Union (USO). The new collective bargaining agreement has a six-year term effective January 1, 2026. No financial terms, stakeholder percentages, or board recommendations are provided. This is a routine labor agreement disclosure that does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
